title: [W]Responding on your own or on behalf of someone else
p1: [W]A representative is someone who can act on your behalf to complete the claim, write to the employment tribunal or present your case at a hearing.

detailsText1.li4: [W]trade unions (if one is available to you)
detailsText1.li6: [W]advisers from law clinics or law centres
detailsText1.p2: [W]Paid representation be through legal professionals, including:
detailsText1.li10: [W]claims management companies (regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA))
